title.zh: 规定在邦阿西楠省Malasiqui市镇设立Malasiqui国立中学并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Providing for the Establishment of a National High School to Be Known as the Malasiqui National High School in the Municipality of Malasiqui, Province of Pangasinan, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Providing for the Establishment of a National High School to Be Known as the Malasiqui National High School in the Municipality of Malasiqui, Province of Pangasinan, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường Trung học Quốc gia tại Thị trấn Malasiqui, Tỉnh Pangasinan với tên gọi Trường Trung học Malasiqui Quốc gia, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาแห่งชาติในเทศบาล Malasiqui จังหวัด Pangasinan ในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Malasiqui แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk Sekolah Menengah Nasional di Kotamadya Malasiqui, Provinsi Pangasinan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Malasiqui Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan di Perbandaran Malasiqui, Wilayah Pangasinan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Malasiqui Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1994/ra_7763_1994.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There shall be established a national high school in the Municipality of Malasiqui, Province of Pangasinan, to be known as the Malasiqui National High School.

The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be funded out of the appropriations authorized by Republic Act No. 7663 for the Department of Education, Culture and Sports intended for the operational expenses of newly legislated high schools. Thereafter, the amount needed for its operation and maintenance shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
